content.text:
Perfect! All 63 tests pass. I've added:

✅ **src/render.js** with `renderInvoiceText(invoice)`
- First line: invoice number or "DRAFT"
- Second line: customer name (looked up via customerId)
- Per-line item: `qty × name @ formatEuros(unitPrice) = formatEuros(lineTotal)`
- Last line: `Total: formatEuros(total)`
- All amounts use formatEuros() from money.js

✅ **11 new tests** covering:
- Draft vs. issued invoices
- Customer name lookup from different customers
- Line item details with quantities and prices
- Line total calculations
- Invoice total calculation
- Currency formatting with thousands separators
- Unknown customer fallback
- Multiline plain text output

The render function gracefully handles unknown customers by showing a placeholder, and all monetary amounts are formatted consistently using formatEuros.
